adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the `onError` handler builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;`. Template literals always produce a string, so `message` is always truthy even when `err.data?.code` is `undefined` (e.g., network/unknown errors), resulting in a toast like `"undefined: ..."` and the `message || t("unable_to_add_guests")` fallback never being used.
